title: Formal letters and emails
description: Open, frame and close a formal message the way Polish institutions expect.

blocks.text: Formal Polish correspondence follows fixed formulas. Open with Szanowna Pani or Szanowny Panie for one person, or Szanowni Państwo for several people or an institution, followed by a comma; the next line starts with a capital letter. Frame the purpose with phrases such as w nawiązaniu do (with reference to) or zwracam się z prośbą o (I am writing to request). Pronouns addressing the reader are often capitalised as a courtesy: Pani, Państwa. Close with Z poważaniem (Yours faithfully) or, less formally, Z wyrazami szacunku.

blocks.note: For an institution or several people.

blocks.text: W nawiązaniu do naszej rozmowy telefonicznej przesyłam umowę.
blocks.translation: With reference to our phone call, I am sending the contract.

blocks.text: Zwracam się z uprzejmą prośbą o przesłanie faktury.
blocks.translation: I am writing to kindly request the invoice.
I would be grateful for a prompt reply.
blocks.note: Said by a woman; a man writes wdzięczny.
